sources.evidence: Crawl of the NEERC archive (seed 'Northern Eurasia Contests', NEERC 2016 page) whose Regional Contests section links a Georgia standings page, plus 2016 and 2017 archive pages; it is the series site, not a Georgia-specific site.
Page 'Georgian Subregional 2016', status over, 40 team rows with columns Rank, Team, A-J, =, Time showing +/- tries and times per problem plus totals rows.
Same page as source 2 (identical size 18736 and content): per-team per-problem grid with tries and times, so it is a scoreboard, not rank-only standings.
Rendered table of 40 teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation and no per-problem columns.

notes: Sources 2 and 3 are the same document at two hostnames (nerc.itmo.ru vs neerc.ifmo.ru), identical size; source 4 is a re-render of icpc.global API data (not the organisers' page), though it adds institutions. Source 1 is the NEERC archive site, filed as web; the crawl also holds the 2017 Georgia standings, which belong to another edition.
